Hello, and thank you for taking the time to review the milestone and provide detailed feedback. I really appreciate it. I’m happy to clarify the points you raised.
1. Performance Test Screenshot
Thank you for pointing this out. The image link has been corrected and can now be accessed here:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kwired/Hydra-Powered-Micro-PaaS/main/docs/Performance-test.png
This screenshot shows the results of the NFT minting benchmark run.
2. Preview vs PreProd Testnet
You are correct that the milestone description originally referenced the Preview testnet. During testing, we encountered stability and synchronization issues between the Hydra node version and the Cardano node environment available on Preview at that time.
To ensure the benchmark could run reliably and produce consistent results, the performance tests were executed on PreProd testnet, where the Hydra node, Cardano node, and Ogmios setup remained stable throughout testing.
The Docker environment and CLI workflow provided in the repository are not tied to a specific testnet, so the same setup can also run on Preview if required. The use of PreProd was purely to ensure a stable environment for benchmarking and does not affect the functionality delivered in the milestone.
3. Verification of the 10,000 Minted NFTs
This benchmark uses Hydra, which operates as an off-chain state channel for Cardano. Transactions—including mint operations—are executed inside the Hydra head and aggregated into snapshots. When the Hydra head commits or closes, the final state is settled on the Cardano ledger.
In this benchmark, 10,000 NFT mint operations were executed inside the Hydra head, which enabled the system to reach the high throughput demonstrated in the benchmark results.
